trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped central depression with a wide aperture angle (approximately 155 degrees) and minimal pixel depth relative to the lobe heights.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency jaggedness with irregular pixel-amplitude variations along the entire trailing boundary, creating a coarse, non-linear silhouette.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curvature across the span of both lobes, terminating in narrow, upward-angled distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Discrete clusters of high-intensity white pixels concentrated at the extreme distal tips and along the trailing edge boundary.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense, rugose high-contrast pixel clusters on the distal ends of the lobes, indicating heavy surface encrustations or localized scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular and jagged trailing edge profile, particularly on the left lobe (viewer perspective), featuring a distinct large-scale indentation.
